sentences.text: It has been contended by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the marriage between the complainant/ respondent No. 2- (wife) and petitioner No. 5 was solemnized on 19.04.2014 as per the Hindu rituals.
After some time of marriage some dispute arose between them and then respondent No. 2 resided separately from him and registered the FIR against her in laws.

He further stated that the complainant/ wife has falsely registered a complaint against the petitioners for under Section 498A ,34 of IPC and Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act at Police Station Mahila Thana,
Raipur and according to her complaint she allegedly said that at the time of marriage, some of the payment made by the father of the respondent No. 2/ complainant through the Bank account of the family members of the petitioner No. 5.
He further stated that the petitioner no. 5 had in many times tried to resolve the dispute between them but the respondent No. 2 was not ready for that.
Learned counsel for the petitioners further stated that petitioners were tried to settle the dispute between them but they were ultimately failed.
He further submits that the present matter be referred to Mediation & conciliation Centre of this Court being matrimonial in nature as there are chances to compromise between the parties.
Considering the fact that the dispute arrived at between the parties is matrimonial in nature, we deem it appropriate to make an effort to get the said dispute settled by way of mediation.

In view of the above, petitioner No.1/husband shall deposit Rs.2,00,000/- with the Mediation Centre of this Court within a period of one week from today and the same shall be paid to respondent No. 2/wife on her appearance before the Mediation Centre.
Parties are directed to appear before the Mediation Centre of this Court on 18.02.2025.
Learned State counsel is directed to inform the private respondent i.e. respondent No. 2 about passing of this order, so that she may appear before the Mediation Centre on the aforesaid date.
List this matter along with report of Mediation Centre before this Court on 04.03.2025.

Till the next date of listing, further criminal proceedings in Criminal Case No. 1754/2019 pending before the learned Judicial Magistrate First Class, Raipur pursuance to the Crime No. 22/2018 registered on 16.04.2018 against the petitioners at Police Station- Mahila Thana, Raipur under Section 498A/34 of IPC and Section 4 of Dowry Prohibition Act shall remain stayed.

It is made clear that in case the aforesaid amount is not deposited within the aforesaid period, the interim protection granted as above shall automatically be vacated and this petition shall stand dismissed without further reference to any Bench of this Court.

The petitioners are directed to produce the copy of the receipt before the concerned trial Court regarding payment of the said money before the Mediation Centre of this Court in pursuance of this Court's order, then only this order shall be given into effect.
It is also made clear that if any final settlement is arrived at between the parties, the aforesaid amount so deposited, shall be adjusted.
